sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Profit Retention is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Luka and his boys repelled those thugs, he said it was a tough fight. And guess what, there's still no sign of the military, the thugs were definitely in on it with them. I guess you can find someone like our Prapor even beyond the cordon, huh? The only issues left are the good ones. They're ready to send a shipment from the other side, but it doesn't fit any of the old schemes. It's a wagonload of equipment! To get it all out, my mate demands a special fee, all in advance. The risks are too fucking high, so we have to pay. This bastard's got a bitcoin farm over there, I reckon."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - This quest is only obtainable by BEAR PMCs.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Hand over the item: 30 Graphics card
- Hand over the item: 15 Physical Bitcoin

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +1 Crafting skill level
- +1 Hideout Management skill level
- +1 Perception skill level
- +1 Attention skill level
- +1 Search skill level
- +1 Immunity skill level
- +1 Health skill level
- +1 Surgery skill level
- +1 Vitality skill level
- +1 Stress Resistance skill level
"All right, get your stash ready. Our money's on its way."
